newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Technologies targeted in suit.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Technologies targeted in suit.

text.p: Another suit requesting class action status has been filed against Centennial Technologies Inc, lawyers for the plaintiffs said Tuesday.

The complaint in the action charges that Centennial Technologies and certain of its senior officers materially overstated, or misrepresented material information about its financial results, according to a statement from the plaintiffs' lawyers.
The company said earlier it expects to restate its financial results for fiscal 1996 ended June 30, 1996, and the first quarter of fiscal 1997.

The suit, filed in U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts, by law firms Berger & Montague and Shapiro Haber & Urmy, seeks to recover damages on behalf of purchasers of Centennial common stock between August 21, 1996, and February 11, 1997.
"I have not seen a copy of the complaint, so I would not want to comment on what's in it," said Don Peck, Centennial's treasurer and corporate counsel.
A number of lawsuits have been filed against Centennial on behalf of purchasers of Centennial securities during varying time periods.
